_comment: Executed. Both declared subjects went through the real DockerBackend twice each: `skillc demo --subject` (installation, in-container digest re-check, client discovery; no model call; the operator's #10 run) and `skillc collection-run` (one real codex agent attempt on evals/level1/slug-small-fix with the collection installed, graded by the fixture's own grader; this #11 run). Every observed line below is cited verbatim from evidence/README.md, and tests/test_second_collection_conformance.py fails if one is not there.

acceptance_status._comment: Each bullet's status is backed by an evidence file or a committed test; see `runs` for the observed lines.
acceptance_status.bullet_1_selection_provenance_license: MET - evals/subjects/mattpocock-skills/SUBJECT.md (#71/#11): independently authored, different layout, compatible capability scope, provenance and licence recorded
acceptance_status.bullet_2_same_client_fixture_contract_gr: MET - one real codex-cli 0.157.1 agent attempt per collection on evals/level1/slug-small-fix (goal.md verbatim, fixture/src only), through agent_trial.run_one_attempt in skill-free canary mode, graded by the fixture's own grader.json in a separate network=none container: both captured, both PASS (evidence/README.md section 2). Collection-specific installation is only the subject declaration's data, delivered by the generic collection_conformance module. Funding basis (quoted verbatim from the operator's ruling on #98): "Normal Claude and codex" - the operator's own normal Codex subscription login, inside the normal usage budget, NOT metered API spend and NOT gated by the #12 $5 cost stop (that ruling covers judge calls only, e.g. mcp-second-opinion, which use provider API keys).
acceptance_status.bullet_3_no_branch_refused_before_select: MET - tests/test_materialize.py's genericity guard (CORE_MODULES, an open set since #94) and test_a_malformed_subject_declaration_is_refused's 10 parametrized cases; cited, not re-proven here
acceptance_status.bullet_4_conformance_evidence_and_compat: MET - installation+discovery conformance (demo --subject, 10/10 MET per subject) and a graded agent run for both collections, in evidence/README.md; the bounded compatibility statement in README.md states exactly that scope. No second benchmark: one attempt per collection on the existing Level 1 canary.
